name: Verita
tagline: Staked accountability for tokenized-equity prices — lie about a price, lose your stake.
signatureElement: The state-flipping verdict card — hero money-moment card whose accent rail, glow, live mark and quote rule flip teal/green (SAFE) to red (REFUSED) when a mark is rejected on-chain.
invariantPhrase: Lie about a price, lose your stake.

statusLegend.meaning: Attested mark accepted within band; the guard permits nothing wrongful.
Mark rejected as unsafe / diverged / slashed; safePrice() reverts and the stake is slashed to the harmed borrower.
Brand accent: interactive controls, links, the kill-shot, and per-read fee (feePot).
